name: The Venetian Resort (Venetian / Palazzo towers)
resort_fee_note: Rates include a daily Resort Fee of $55 plus tax per night, payable upon check-in. The Resort Fee includes: Access for two to the fitness facility within the Canyon Ranch spa + fitness; In-suite internet access (WiFi or Ethernet); Boarding pass printing; Unlimited local and toll-free calls; Access to thousands of top newspapers and magazines using PressReader app.  ||  Re-read on 2026-11-19.
address: 3355 Las Vegas Blvd. South, Las Vegas, NV 89109
parking: Hotel guests $20 per day; non-guests $20 per day Mon-Thu and $25 per day Fri-Sun; valet $40 per day; Nevada residents the first 3 hours free; Sapphire+ self-parking free, Ruby+ valet free (official hotel terms, read 2026-11-19). Poker validation: registered hotel guests and non-registered players with 3+ hours of live play are comped self-parking (official poker pages).
cancel: One night's room rate and tax (or the full stay for some offers) charged as the deposit when the reservation is confirmed; prepaid offers are non-cancellable and non-refundable; a no-show cancels the entire reservation and forfeits the first-night deposit; early departure fee $100 plus tax (official hotel terms, read 2026-11-19).
poker_rate: 2026 Special Suite Rates. We offer suite rates for poker players who are interested in staying in either The Venetian or The Palazzo. These rates will start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher. Future rates are only provided out to a maximum of 150 days from the current date. Rates are subject to qualifying poker play and availability based on hotel occupancy. Blackout dates may apply. Rates are based on single/double occupancy in a Luxury King Suite in The Venetian or The Palazzo. There is a $55 resort fee per night stayed.
quality_note: AAA Five Diamond (Palazzo). On the same property as the Venetian poker room.
poker_rate_condition: During your stay, you will be required to play six hours of active live cash gameplay or buy in to a $300 or higher tournament for each night stayed ... prior to 2 a.m. the last night stayed. For any nights you fail to complete these requirements, your nightly suite rate will be adjusted to the prevailing rate.
poker_rate_booking: book the suite by calling 866.255.8936 and mentioning code EPOKR25; a Venetian Rewards account is required
rate_floor_room: Luxury King Suite in The Venetian or The Palazzo, single/double occupancy - the page names two starting figures, $119 and $209, without mapping them to the two towers
rate_caveat: Published starting rate, not a quote: the official page says rates "start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher"; it is conditional on six hours of live play or a $300+ tournament entry every night, and rates are only published 150 days out, so December 2026 is not yet on it. Booked by phone on a Venetian Rewards account.
tax_note: Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38% (official hotel terms).
check_in_out: Check-in 3:00 p.m., check-out 11:00 a.m. (official hotel terms).

name: Wynn Las Vegas / Encore
resort_fee_note: Resort Fee: A daily resort fee of $55 plus tax will be added to your room account for each room night, which entitles you to receive complimentary self-parking for up to two vehicles; in-room Wi-Fi of 15 Mbps on an unlimited number of devices; complimentary bottled water, refreshed daily; unlimited local, domestic long distance (including HI and AK) and toll free calls; access for up to two persons to our fitness center; and a digital newsstand of magazines and newspapers.  ||  Applicability: offer text: 'only available on select dates from October 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027'; blackout dates listed include November 17-21, 2026 and December 31, 2026 The same fee sentence also appears on https://www.wynnlasvegas.com/terms-and-conditions/850070 (an offer whose stay had to end 2025-09-30, used here only to corroborate the figure). Flag F28 stays open: the fee is a rate-plan term, not a property-wide published rate, so confirm it on your own rate plan.
parking: Self-parking is complimentary to registered guests; the $55 resort fee includes complimentary self-parking for up to two vehicles; incidentals $150 per night (official terms, read 2026-11-19).
cancel: Deposit of one night's room rate and tax charged at booking; free cancellation until 72 hours before arrival on the Flexible Getaway and 'Your Fall to Have It All' rates (one night's room rate and tax penalty after that), and until 48 hours before arrival on offer DK26WLV2 and the Wynn Rewards Exclusive rate (read 2026-11-19).
quality_note: On the same property as the Wynn poker room: the official WPT terms state the poker room is 'located in Encore at Wynn Las Vegas'.
incidentals: plus $150 a night for incidentals must be presented upon check-in
occupancy: A $50 surcharge per guest shall be added for each guest exceeding the two (2) person limit. Maximum occupancy for all standard rooms is 4 people.
rate_caveat: Only a floor: from-prices without dates ('Flexible Getaway From $319', 'Your Fall to Have It All From $253'). For the recommended window (Dec 6-13, 2026) dated quotes of $818 and $688 average per night (fee included, taxes excluded) are captured in the rate log. Two member plans show sign-in-only prices.
address: 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. South, Las Vegas, NV 89109
